description: Javen Sears officially announces his campaign for Vermont State Senate in Chittenden Southeast County on WVMT 101.3 FM, discussing housing, taxes, ICE, and youth issues, with support from former Governor Jim Douglas.
title: Javen Sears Launches Vermont State Senate Campaign with Support from Jim Douglas on WVMT 101.3 FM — Javen Sears | Candidate for Vermont State Senate
